Kohler Distributing · Tap Tracker

What's actually on tap, by rep

Every surveyed tap, grouped by rep → account → brand. Each rep's book of accounts is scored Ours vs. Competitor by tap handle; drill into an account to see its brands, when it was last visited, and its most recent photo.

Ours — carried & in territory Competitor Unverified — no US/THEM flag on file ⇆ corrected = iSellBeer's own survey flag was wrong here; hover for why

How to read this: each rep card shows a pie of their book's tap handles — Ours vs. Competitor (by # of Taps, not just row count, so an account with 3 handles of the same brand counts as 3). Expand a rep to see their accounts, sorted by tap count; expand an account to see its individual brands, each tagged Ours or Competitor.

US / THEM source: built from the tap-audit engine's own working file (the iSellBeer Corrected/US vs THEM Mediator workbook), not a flat pre-corrected export. Every brand is checked against Kohler's product catalog and Brand Family Territory rules; where iSellBeer's own survey flag disagrees with that check, the row is marked ⇆ corrected and hovering the badge shows why. were corrected this way.

Photos: shown per account using the real photo link behind each survey's "Photos" cell — a plain CSV export of this same report flattens that link to text, so a future refresh from a .csv (instead of the full mediator workbook) would lose photos again.

Visit date: this export is one snapshot in time — each account appears with a single visit date. Refresh by re-exporting and re-running generate.py; a future export with repeat visits per account would show the most recent one.
